items.title: BTS signs USD 12.8M AI enablement and implementation deal with leading, global company
items.summary: BTS signs USD 12.8M AI enablement and implementation deal with leading, global company 2026-10-02 12:20:00 STOCKHOLM, SWEDEN - BTS Group AB (publ), a leading global consultancy specializing in strategy execution, change, and people development, has signed a USD 12.8M deal to provide AI enablement and implementation services on behalf of a leading, global company. The contract covers Q3 and Q4 2026, as well as Q1 2027, with the majority occurring in Q4 2026.
